responsibility: This file declares the extra machine modes required by the MIPS backend beyond GCC’s common defaults. It adds MIPS-specific scalar, vector, fixed-point, and condition-code modes such as TF, MSA vector widths, paired-single comparison CCV2/CCV4, DSP condition state CCDSP, and floating-point condition mode CCF, supplying the backend’s fundamental mode inventory used by instruction patterns, register classes, and builtins.
